lastEpisodeToAir.name: Paldea in Ruin: Reunion (3)
lastEpisodeToAir.overview: Protect Orange Academy and everyone's campus festival! The Ruinous Pokémon head towards Table City from the four corners of Paldea. If the four were to gather, a catastrophe would unavoidable... Liko and the other split into four groups and do their upmost to stop the Ruinous Pokémon, but find themselves getting more and more driven against the wall by their overwhelming power. And then, the four ultimately meet up...?!

nextEpisodeToAir.name: Syaritatsu, Order Up!
nextEpisodeToAir.overview: Liko and the others take the Syaritatsu with them to Lake Zugogo, where they meet a group of Heyrusher! The Syaritatsu are curious about the Heyrusher, however... it looks like the Heyrusher are scared of something? It turns out they're actually being bullied by cruel Migalusa that live in the lake... But when the Syaritatsu learn this, they suddenly jump into the Heyrusher's mouths...?!

overview: Follow Liko and Roy as they unravel the mysteries that surround them and encounter Friede, Captain Pikachu, Amethio, and others during their exciting adventures!

seasons.name: Series 1
seasons.overview: A new adventure is beginning within the wide world of Pokémon! Arriving at Indigo Academy, a little girl named Liko receives her first partner Pokémon, Sprigatito. But she soon finds herself pursued by the Explorers, a mysterious group that's determined to take the pendant necklace she wears. Liko isn't on her own, though, as Friede, Captain Pikachu, and the other Rising Volt Tacklers offer her protection aboard their airship. Meanwhile, a young boy named Roy dreams of becoming a Pokémon Trainer, unaware of the secret hiding within the Ancient Poké Ball he carries. As Liko, Roy, and the Rising Volt Tacklers set sail for new horizons, what kind of discoveries await?

title: Pokémon Horizons
